## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature / screen
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] chore — tooling, CI, deps
- [ ] style — UI polish only

## Checklist

- [ ] UI stays simple and functional (backend is the showcase)
- [ ] No live secrets / `.env` values committed
- [ ] Uses public API contract only (no hardcoded private credentials)
- [ ] Loading / empty / error states handled for user-facing flows
- [ ] Works on desktop and mobile viewport for changed screens
- [ ] Lint / typecheck / build pass (when scripts exist)
- [ ] README updated if run instructions or env vars changed
